bio.text: Alvin Payton Jr. was elected on June 9, 2026, in a special election runoff to complete the term of Dexter Sharper as state representative for Georgia House District 177.
He served on the Valdosta City Council for twelve years, ten of them as mayor pro tempore.

Born in Valdosta, he holds a business administration degree from Northeastern State University and a master's and doctorate in Public Administration from Valdosta State University, and he retired from Wiregrass Georgia Technical College.
